name: corteel_and_recovery
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
l=Path.cwd();z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(l/'sources/corteel.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(l/'write_lane.py'),'sources/corteel.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print('CORTEEL',z.stdout[:24000]);s=Path('sources/roller.txt').read_text();print('ROLLER END',s[20000:])
